record.reason: ESPN compresses multi-vector neural retrieval indexes to reduce memory/storage while preserving retrieval, including a memory-efficient partial re-ranking design. This is IR index efficiency rather than generation/inference of an LLM; the microexponent lineage connection is weak but plausible for retrieval systems.
